parameters.name: DispatchValue
parameters.description:
The key for the log category. Valid values:

**internet\_log**

**vpc\_firewall\_log**

**nat\_firewall\_log**

**ipv6\_firewall\_log**

**dns\_firewall\_log**.

parameters.name: EnableStatus
parameters.description: Specifies whether to deliver logs. A value of \`true\` enables delivery, and \`false\` disables it.

parameters.name: FilterKeys
parameters.description:
The supported filter conditions. Valid values:

**attack**

**acl**

**other**.

parameters.name: Site
parameters.description: The site to modify. If the log version is 1, leave this parameter empty or set it to \`global\`. If the log version is 2, set this parameter to \`cn\` or \`intl\`.
